description: Expander for Operator, sitting immediately to its right: it lays the DX7 routing out as a matrix of sixteen slots on a wrapping field, and travels across it so the routing changes under held notes

params.text: Sets how fast the point travels across the field, in slots per second
Sets whatever gives the current movement its character: the heading, how much it turns, how far it wanders, or the radius
Sets how far the blend is pushed away from the path the engine would take on its own
Switches clock quantising on, so the point's position is snapped to the nearest slot on each clock rather than moving continuously
Picks how the point moves: Drift, Turtle, Random walk, Circle or Linear

inputs.text: Changes the travel speed, ±5V added to the speed knob
Changes the movement's character, ±5V added to the shape knob
Snaps the travelling point to the nearest slot on each rise; in Linear movement a rise instead steps one slot forward
A rise returns the point to the first slot
Changes how far the blend is pushed, ±5V added to the depth knob
Picks the movement, one volt per mode, added to the movement knob

notes: nothing happens until an Operator is placed immediately to the left; the module has no sound of its own
both axes of the field wrap round, so travelling in one direction for ever passes through every column and comes back into the first with no jump in the routing
the matrix is the editing surface: clicking a cell silences or restores that route, and dragging or scrolling a slot changes its algorithm; no click there reaches a help entry
four of the fifteen possible modulation routes appear in none of the thirty-two DX7 algorithms and can only be reached by switching a cell on by hand
menu: Slots — each holds one algorithm — a label over the slot submenus below it
Row 1 — a submenu of the four slots in that row, each choosing one of the thirty-two algorithms
Row 2 — a submenu of the four slots in that row, each choosing one of the thirty-two algorithms
Row 3 — a submenu of the four slots in that row, each choosing one of the thirty-two algorithms
Row 4 — a submenu of the four slots in that row, each choosing one of the thirty-two algorithms
